Featured case study

Conservation prioritization under climate change

A citable GIS and machine learning decision-support framework using California mountain lions as a demonstration species.

GIS · Random Forest · Climate · Optimization

Where should California prioritize limited conservation funding?

This project integrates species occurrence records, climate projections, wildfire history, protected-area coverage, least-cost corridor modeling, and budget-constrained optimization across California. The output is not just a habitat map; it is a decision framework that compares ecological value, climate resilience, connectivity, protection gaps, and implementation constraints.
